channel.title: ALTRENDAT
channel.description: What the world is searching for, explained with sources

item.title: Germany Routs Netherlands 5-0 to Snatch Top Spot in Nations League Group
item.description: Germany clinched first place in Group A2 after defeating the Netherlands 5-0 in their final Nations League group stage match.

item.title: United Airlines ground system outage prevents aircraft from receiving critical takeoff data
item.description: United Airlines flights faced delays Monday as a widespread system outage stopped dispatch data from reaching departing aircraft.

item.title: Canada’s nationwide emergency alert system blares during second test of 2026
item.description: Canada will conduct a nationwide test of the Alert Ready emergency notification system across all provinces and territories on Wednesday, Nov. 18.

item.title: Ja'Marr Chase dominates Steelers with 231 receiving yards in Bengals 38-18 victory
item.description: Cincinnati wide receiver Ja'Marr Chase hauled in 231 yards during a dominant 38-18 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers in Week 10 of the 2026 season.

item.title: Amazon MGM Studios officially names Robert Pattinson as the new James Bond
item.description: Robert Pattinson has been confirmed by Amazon MGM Studios as the successor to Daniel Craig for the legendary secret agent role.

item.title: Fans slam ITV reporter Gabriel Clarke for twisting Declan Rice's match comments
item.description: ITV broadcaster Gabriel Clarke faced intense public backlash after misrepresenting Declan Rice's post-match remarks during an interview with manager Thomas Tuchel.

item.title: Robert Pattinson Officially Clinches Role of Legendary Secret Agent James Bond
item.description: Amazon MGM Studios confirmed Robert Pattinson as the next 007 actor, succeeding Daniel Craig's five-movie run.

item.title: Wayne Rooney Storms the Jungle for 26th Year of I'm A Celebrity
item.description: Wayne Rooney leads the celebrity cast as the 26th season of I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! premieres on ITV on Monday, 16 November.

item.title: Billy Evans Defends Involvement In Controversial Elizabeth Holmes Documentary You Can See Everything
item.description: Billy Evans, partner of Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes, defends his participation in the documentary You Can See Everything despite his portrayal as an antagonist.

item.title: Bowen Yang returns to SNL as Jensen Huang in tech mogul spoof
item.description: Former SNL cast member Bowen Yang played former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang in a cold open sketch featuring tech billionaires at CIA headquarters.

item.title: Herman Mashaba Rejects Bullying Claims as Johannesburg Coalition Negotiations Heat Up
item.description: ActionSA leader Herman Mashaba asserts his party’s independence amid ongoing coalition talks as Johannesburg’s electrical grid faces critical failures.

item.title: Severe storms and damaging winds strike South Africa with temperatures reaching 36°C
item.description: Vox Weather issued severe thunderstorm and damaging wind warnings for Eastern South Africa on 16 November.

item.title: TV host Will Best and Dianne Buswell exit Strictly ahead of Blackpool
item.description: Will Best and his professional partner Dianne Buswell were eliminated from Strictly Come Dancing in the seventh dance-off of the series.

item.title: England Stuns World Champions Spain In 3-2 Nations League Thriller Victory
item.description: England ended Spain's 43-game unbeaten run with a 3-2 victory at the Metropolitano in Sunday's Nations League clash.

item.title: France clinches Nations League quarter-final spot after 2-1 victory over Turkiye
item.description: France secured the top spot in Group A1 of the UEFA Nations League by defeating Turkiye 2-1 at the Matmut Atlantique.

item.title: Andy Farrell benches stars to protect front-liners for clash against South Africa
item.description: Ireland secured a 43-15 victory over Fiji at Aviva Stadium in the Nations Championship.

item.title: Billy Evans invites cameras home for 34 days before Elizabeth Holmes imprisonment
item.description: Partner Billy Evans discusses his controversial portrayal in the new documentary You Can See Everything during his first television interview.

item.title: Wales Ends 73-Year Drought With 35-28 Victory Over New Zealand
item.description: Wales defeated New Zealand for the first time in 73 years during a match in Cardiff on 14 November 2026.

item.title: 3.4 Magnitude Earthquake Shakes Northern Utah Residents in Weber and Davis Counties
item.description: A 3.4 magnitude earthquake struck near Huntsville on Saturday at 6:40 p.m., prompting hundreds of reports of light shaking.

item.title: India collapses to 209 as Sharma and Kohli struggle in New Zealand
item.description: New Zealand bowled out India for 209 in the fifth ODI at Bay Oval on Sunday, as key batters Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli fell early.

item.title: Liam Martin storms home in 84 seconds as Australia leads World Cup
item.description: Australia established an early six-point lead against New Zealand in the 2026 Men's Rugby League World Cup final in Brisbane.

item.title: Chiefs Rule Out Star Running Back Kenneth Walker III for Week 10
item.description: Kansas City Chiefs running back Kenneth Walker III is officially ruled out for Sunday following a groin injury.

item.title: Ethan and Gehlee perform Lullaby as housemates reach day 22 inside
item.description: Housemates Ethan Benares and Gehlee delivered a performance of the song Lullaby on day 22 of Pinoy Big Brother Celebrity Collab Edition 3.0.

item.title: Jillaroos storm to fourth straight World Cup title routing Kiwi Ferns 34-10
item.description: The Australian Jillaroos secured their fourth consecutive Rugby League World Cup title after a dominant 34-10 victory over the Kiwi Ferns at Suncorp Stadium.

item.title: Proteas Target World Test Championship Points in Two-Match Series Against Bangladesh
item.description: South Africa travels to face Bangladesh in a two-match Test series while aiming to secure crucial World Test Championship points.

item.title: Cach and Maddie Charge Ahead With Series-Best Charleston During Week 8 Strictly
item.description: Cach and Maddie earned praise for the dance of the series while Dani and Nikita faced judge criticism over illegal lifts.

item.title: SpaceX Starship upper stage clinches historic catch at Texas launch tower
item.description: SpaceX successfully caught the Starship upper stage using mechanical arms at its Starbase facility after a 14-orbit test flight.

item.title: India Stuns Pakistan With Last-Ball Victory In U-19 Asia Cup Final
item.description: India clinched the U-19 Asia Cup title by chasing down a 338-run target with one wicket remaining on the final delivery in Muscat.

item.title: Five Lotto Players Pocket $200,000 Each As Powerball Hits $18 Million
item.description: Five lucky players across New Zealand won $200,000 each in the latest Lotto First Division draw while the Powerball jackpot rolled over to $18 million.

item.title: Rasmus Hojlund scores twice as Denmark routs Portugal in Nations League clash
item.description: Denmark secured a 4-1 victory over Portugal in Braga as the hosts played their first match following Cristiano Ronaldo's international retirement.

item.title: Nathan Collins returns to lead Ireland against Austria in Nations League clash
item.description: Captain Nathan Collins and two other defenders return to the starting line-up for Ireland's UEFA Nations League match against Austria on November 14th.

item.title: Ayyoub Bouaddi dominates midfield as Morocco routs Niger in Casablanca qualifier
item.description: Morocco maintained its perfect record in Africa Cup of Nations qualifying by defeating Niger 5-1 in Casablanca.

item.title: Springboks Regain World Number One Ranking After Wales Stuns All Blacks
item.description: South Africa climbed back to the top of the World Rugby rankings on Saturday following a 35-28 loss for New Zealand against Wales in Cardiff.

item.title: Groin injury benches Kansas City star Kenneth Walker III for Week 10
item.description: Kansas City Chiefs running back Kenneth Walker III will miss Sunday’s game against the Atlanta Falcons due to a groin injury.

item.title: No. 20 Ohio State targets redemption against Northwestern in Big Ten clash
item.description: No. 20 Ohio State hosts Northwestern at Ohio Stadium on Saturday with kickoff set for noon ET as the Buckeyes seek to end a two-game losing streak.

item.title: England shuffles squad for Nations Championship showdown against winless Japan at Twickenham
item.description: England hosts Japan at Twickenham in a Nations Championship clash as coach Steve Borthwick rotates his starting lineup.

item.title: France holds off Springboks to clinch narrow 21-19 Nations Championship victory
item.description: France secured a 21-19 victory over South Africa on Friday, ending an 11-match drought against the Springboks in Paris.

item.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Surges Past $1 Billion In Preorder Sales Revenue
item.description: Rockstar Games will launch Grand Theft Auto VI on Nov. 19 following an estimated development cost exceeding $1 billion.

item.title: FAA Lifts Nationwide Ground Stop After 3,800 Saturday Flights Are Cancelled
item.description: The FAA ended a five-hour nationwide ground stop on Friday after a telecommunications outage involving legacy system routers disrupted thousands of flights.

item.title: Beauden Barrett Captains New Zealand Side Boasting 783 Total Test Caps
item.description: New Zealand faces Wales at Principality Stadium this Saturday in the Nations Championship with Beauden Barrett leading the team for the first time.
